payload.reason: The evidence provides specific evaluation criteria and metrics used to assess the generated text, including gold standard selection, edit distance, word error rate, and BLEU scores.

claims.text: The evaluation includes gold standard event selection for comparing generated text to reference text.
Edit distance is used as a measure of the effort needed to correct the generated output.
The word error rate (WER) of the generated text is reported as 5.6%.
BLEU scores are used to evaluate the fluency of the generated text, although higher scores may correlate with factual mistakes.
The usability of the generated text for a news channel is also evaluated.
